rounds.q: What % of Americans plan to celebrate Halloween this year?
rounds.src: National Retail Federation, Halloween survey (2026 data)
rounds.fun: Nearly 3 in 4 Americans are joining the fun. Happy Halloween!

rounds.q: What % of US parents admit sneaking candy from their kids' Halloween haul?
rounds.why: Candy corn splits fans too: 60% eat it in one bite and 28% start with the white tip.
rounds.src: National Confectioners Association, Halloween survey (2026 data)
rounds.fun: 83% of parents take a little candy tax. The kids never stood a chance!

rounds.q: On average, how much will each US Halloween fan spend this year?
rounds.why: The exact figure is $115.14, and costumes ($4.4 billion) beat candy ($4.1 billion).
rounds.src: National Retail Federation, Halloween survey (2026 data)
rounds.fun: About $115 each for spooky fun, and costumes win out over candy!

rounds.q: What % of the pumpkins grown in the US come from Illinois?
rounds.why: Illinois grew 533 million of 1.47 billion US pounds in 2025, and about 70% of its fields grow them to can.
rounds.src: USDA Economic Research Service, pumpkin statistics (2025 data)
rounds.fun: More than a third of US pumpkins come from Illinois. Pumpkin champ!

rounds.q: How many pounds did the heaviest pumpkin ever grown weigh?
rounds.why: The same grower set the record back in 2006 with a pumpkin of 1,502 lbs.
rounds.fun: Over 3,000 pounds of pumpkin! More than double the 2006 record.
